entry.title: OrthoFinder-v3.1.5
entry.content:
📦 orthofinder-linux-intel-3.1.5.tar.gz

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed packaging and installation issues for OrthoFinder utility scripts in pip/conda environments.
  • Improved robustness of utility scripts, including recursive directory handling, archive processing, and compatibility with ETE4 ultrametric tree generation.
  • Added several new command-line utilities and enhanced existing tools for transcript processing, orthogroup gene counts, HOG FASTA generation, and tree ID conversion.

entry.title: OrthoFinder-v3.1.1
entry.content:
📦 orthofinder-linux-intel-3.1.1.tar.gz

New

  • Added a test module to improve robustness of future changes.

Improvements

  • Upgraded the tree-handling backend from ete3 to ete4.
  • Updated the README to better highlight and clarify the changes introduced in v3.1.0.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue affecting the trimming of multiple sequence alignments.
  • Resolved a newline character handling bug.
  • Applied additional minor bug fixes and internal code clean-ups.

entry.title: OrthoFinder-v3.1.0
entry.content:
📦 orthofinder-linux-intel-3.1.0.tar.gz

Faster, leaner, and ready for thousands of genomes

This is the new release of OrthoFinder, to allow scalable analysis. This version replaces the beta version of OrthoFinder v3 (v3.0.1b1), which was released October 7th 2024.

New in this release

  • All output files now refer to phylogenetic hierarchical orthogroups, rather than orthogroups solely determined by MCL clustering
  • FAMSA is now the default program for multiple sequence alignment
  • Accurate progress bar to monitor the progress of each step of the OrthoFinder workflow
  • The ability to use a custom config file is now available to conda users

author.name: David Emms, Jonathan Holmes, Laurence Belcher, Yi Liu
